title: Which club will sign Djed Spence on a permanent transfer from Tottenham Hotspur during summer 2026?
background: Djed Spence is a Tottenham Hotspur player.
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : An official announcement from Tottenham Hotspur or the receiving club confirming a completed permanent transfer. 
  Resolution Conditions : Resolve to the club that signs Djed Spence directly from Tottenham Hotspur on a permanent transfer between June 1 and August 31, 2026. Loan agreements and unconfirmed transfer reports do not count. 
  Accepted Answer Format : The name of the receiving club.
